apiKey.title: Jobs API token
apiKey.description: Your personal token. Sign in to the jobs site with your @pursuit.org Google account and click "Get actor token". Getting a new token revokes the old one.

serverUrl.title: Jobs API URL
serverUrl.description: Leave as is unless you've been told otherwise.

maxQueries.title: Searches per run
maxQueries.description: Each search costs about $0.015 per result in YOUR Apify account (about $0.15 at 10 results). At 1 search a day, the free plan's monthly credit covers it.

resultsPerQuery.title: Results per search
resultsPerQuery.description: Postings fetched per search. This is what you pay for. The server accepts at most 50.
